title: The record section of a "classification" claim: record["classification"]
description: A classification claim: whether Sensible classifies each file, sent with a content type, as the test's fixture doc type

fixture.description: The fixture doc type the files are classified as (persistent in the test account)

editor.description: The SenseML editor, opened on the fixture

doc_type_description.description: The fixture's description, which Sensible classifies by

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file sent

label.description: Optional name for the request in reports

expected.description: Whether the page claims Sensible classifies it

actual.description: Whether Sensible classified it as the fixture doc type

response.description: The start of the response body, keys redacted

curl.description: The request as a curl command, run from the repo root, with the key as an environment variable
